name: 対象の本文と既読情報の確認
prompt:
Create a standalone Japanese mobile “message information” component on a clean white canvas, exactly 390 × 291 px in layout and a portrait 1.34:1 aspect ratio. Use the Japanese native preview as the exact layout, typography scale, spacing, colors, and copy reference. Use the original screenshot crop to preserve the message-info structure and recognizable source details. No device frame, status bar, home indicator, watermark, or extra text.

Copy this text exactly: メッセージの情報; 今日; 明日の9時に集まれますか？; 編集済み; 00:49; 既読; 未確認; 配信済み; 今日 00:50.

Layout: centered dark bold heading at the top; a small pale-mint 今日 pill beneath it; a right-aligned light-green rounded message bubble with the message in two lines at most. In that message, color the phrase 明日の9時 blue and underline it as a hyperlink, because the matching source phrase “9 am tomorrow!” is underlined as a detected link. Keep に集まれますか？ dark. Place the small 編集済み, 00:49, and green double-check status along the bubble’s lower edge. Beneath it, place a wide pale-mint status card with two evenly spaced rows and a thin divider: row one has a green double-check, dark 既読, and muted-gray 未確認 aligned right; row two has a gray double-check, dark 配信済み, and muted-gray 今日 00:50 aligned right.

Keep all other text dark or muted gray. The linked phrase 明日の9時 is the only blue text. Match the preview’s compact, calm hierarchy, rounded shapes, clean Meiryo-like Japanese sans serif, and generous white space. Make every Japanese character crisp and legible; preserve the exact punctuation and spacing above. No decorative wallpaper or photo artwork.
reviewNotes: Exact Japanese copy and blue-underlined 明日の9時 link. Layout ratio is portrait instead of the 390x291 landscape target; second bounded attempt will correct it.
